Hand-written pages in each ATS's application-form shape (specs/022 "Testing"), for
`apply/ats_forms.py`. Synthetic and empty: no real posting, no personal data. Never fetched by
tooling. `form.html` is the form, `error.html` the form after a validation failure,
`confirmation.html` the confirmation view where the ATS shows one in place, `parsed.html` the
form after the ATS parsed an uploaded resume.
